import copy
import runpy

app = runpy.run_path('src/app.py')
total = app['stock_total']
for quantities, expected in [
    ([], 0),
    ([-9, -1], 0),
    ([0], 0),
    ([5, -12, 0, 8], 13),
    ([-2, 7, -4, 1, 3], 11),
    ([2, 4], 6),
]:
    items = [{'name': 'Item %s' % index, 'quantity': quantity} for index, quantity in enumerate(quantities)]
    before = copy.deepcopy(items)
    assert total(items) == expected, 'Wrong nonnegative stock total'
    assert items == before, 'Total calculation changed input records or ordering'
assert app['empty_message']() == 'No items saved.', 'Existing empty message changed'
